title: GitHub Security Lab AI agent helps find untrusted-checkout secret exposure in Datadog action
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent and CodeQL
summary: The e2e-target workflow checks out a potentially attacker-controlled workflow_run head SHA, then installs/builds and executes that code while the DATADOG_API_KEY secret is available.
ai_role: GHSL credits CodeQL and its AI agent. Reported 2025-08-05; maintainer fixed it 2025-08-10. Their individual contributions are not distinguished.
classification_note: The public advisory documents the vulnerability and disclosure/remediation status. It does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Maintainer fixed the issue 2025-08-10. No CVE was established in this advisory.

impacts.conditions: An attacker-controlled pull request branch is checked out and its code runs in a GitHub Actions workflow; malicious package scripts can execute in that workflow and potentially leak its secrets.
impacts.exploitation: Exploitation in the wild is not established by the cited description.
